boundary: Automated original-content solvability witnesses, not human balance or enjoyment validation.
method: Pure core half-degree trajectory corpus; prefer direct/low-bounce shortest routes; greedy search with width10 beam fallback. Deterministic authored seeds chosen to reduce forced queue busywork. Stored witnesses replay unchanged core.
authoring: Fifty separately designed occupied topologies across ten ordered chapters. Each Standard and Compact variant is explicitly stored as row strings, rather than cropping or procedurally generating a layout at runtime.
